Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. Catalyst is working through the SIG/CAIQ scoping and we need to collect the following to close 'Encryption & Key Management' items:

- A recent sample of KMS rotation logs showing operator IDs and timestamps (last 90 days).

Anna —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested. Proposed plan:

1) Rotation logs: we'll export a redacted sample (operator IDs hashed, timestamps preserved) covering the last 90 days and upload to a gated Drive folder.
2) HSM access matrix: export of current operator roles, key guardianship model, and a short narrative describing our split-ceremony process.
3) Backup attest: one-page signed attestation confirming tenant key wrapping and backup handling (no plaintext key material stored).

Quick clarifications: when you say "operator IDs" — do you need raw LDAP usernames or is a consistent pseudonymized id (hash) acceptable? We typically pseudonymize for exports to external auditors.

I'll coordinate the export and will share a secure Drive link and an expiring S3 pre-signed URL. Ben, can you help with the attestation PDF and include the current retention policy statement? Irene, please pull the HSM operator matrix and a 1-paragraph split-ceremony description.

Targeting delivery EOD Thu (2028-06-15). If Catalyst needs earlier, we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
